title: Noise vs Music
description: Baron Mute floods the city with harsh noise. Tell noise from music to begin reforging the Harmony Bell.

content.value: Not all sounds feel the same to us. MUSIC is a sound that is pleasant to hear. NOISE is a sound that is unpleasant, harsh, or unwanted. The difference is mostly about whether the sound is smooth and regular or rough and jarring.

MUSIC 🎶                    NOISE 🔊
pleasant, smooth            unpleasant, harsh
regular vibrations          irregular vibrations
e.g. a flute, singing       e.g. traffic, machinery
It Can Depend on the Situation

Sometimes the same sound can be music to one person and noise to another. Loud music you love might be noise to a neighbour trying to sleep. A sound becomes 'noise' when it is unwanted or too loud for the moment.
Pleasant sounds can relax us, but too much harsh, loud noise is tiring and even harmful to health. That's why controlling noise — which you'll learn next — is so important for a healthy life.

The key difference: musical sounds come from regular, repeating vibrations, while noise comes from irregular, jumbled vibrations. Loudness alone doesn't decide it — but very loud sound is usually experienced as noise.
Key Takeaway: Music is pleasant sound from regular vibrations; noise is unpleasant or unwanted sound from irregular vibrations. The same sound can be music or noise depending on the situation.

quiz.question: Music is best described as a sound that is…
options: pleasant to hear, from regular vibrations
quiz.explain: Music is pleasant sound produced by regular, repeating vibrations.

quiz.question: Noise usually comes from vibrations that are…
quiz.explain: Noise is harsh, unwanted sound from irregular vibrations.

quiz.question: Can the same sound be music to one person and noise to another?
options: Yes, it can depend on the situation
No, sounds are fixed as one or the other
quiz.explain: A sound becomes 'noise' when it is unwanted — so it can differ from person to person.
